explanation: Bounded source-review acceptance: internal/plugins/iface/netlink/monitor_linux.go (monitor.start, seedLinkNames, handleLinkUpdate) preserves subscription-before-snapshot ordering, emits created followed by current carrier state on the first RTM_NEWLINK, retains repeated-state notifications, and clears both caches on deletion; server.deliverEvent, iface.subscribeLinkEvents/applyLinkEvent and runRSVPTEEngine explicitly route the existing payloads, with interface coalescing retaining the latest carrier state rather than suppressing RSVP's separate down subscription. TestIntegrationMonitorPreexistingLinkDown uses actual native startup after creating an up dummy, without manually priming monitor state, while the amended deletion/up-down tests observe initial up and clear creation-time events before their later assertions; registerRSVPTE's added interface dependency leads through interface → sysctl without a new cycle or startup callback wait, and the scoped documentation/comments match these paths. No patch-introduced defect found, but all execution remains owed to Main: focused tests, native old-return RED/repaired GREEN, the unchanged full producer, and an independent RSVP-only dependency negative control—TestRSVPNativeProducer includes OSPF, whose existing interface dependency masks this registration defect, and attempt-010's timeout is consistent with the lost-first-notification mechanism rather than proven caused by it until the native discrimination runs.
